title: SNB: September policy discussion summary
facts: SNB schedules its policy discussion summary for October 22 at 9:30 AM Swiss local time.
time_note: Swiss summer time conversion gives 2:30 PM Jakarta.
interpretation: NZDCHF short reassessment: this is a retrospective summary of the September decision, not a new rate decision. Unexpectedly strong concern about CHF appreciation, FX intervention or a lower future policy path could weaken CHF and challenge the short. Firmer inflation/policy reasoning can support CHF. Judge genuinely new information against the September release and current conditions.
